title: LeBron James Shows Early Chemistry with 76ers in Season Opener
text:
In his 24th NBA season, LeBron James contributed 10 points, five assists, and four rebounds in the first half of the Philadelphia 76ers' exhibition game, highlighting his playmaking and integration with new teammates including Joel Embiid.
But every first game of a season feels new, even for a player who's now had 24 of them. James certainly picked things up quickly to start the expected final stop of his career with a strong first half in the 76ers' exhibition game against the “Obviously, I was wearing a new uniform, but the game is the game, and the game is needed to be played on the floor,” James said.
“And I was happy to be able to log some minutes with the guys that we’ve been going at each other in practice for the last two weeks, a week and a half, or whatever the case may be. ”-record 24th season, had 10 points, five assists and four rebounds in the first half, helping the 76ers to a 58-56 lead.
The 41-year-old forward was credited with only one shot from the field in 18 minutes, though was fouled four times and made all eight free throws. James didn’t even attempt a shot until he was fouled on a drive to the basket with 4:54 remaining in the first quarter. But with Philadelphia’s firepower, the NBA's career scoring leader might not need to look for his offense very much.
The 76ers got a first look at the potent lineup they put together this summer. James and fellow All-Star newcomerThe 76ers missed their first shot when James threw a pass low toward Embiid's feet. The 7-footer caught it awkwardly but was off-balance and shot an airball on a turnaround jumper. Philadelphia then made its next seven shots, with James finding open men himself or on one possession slipping a pass to Embiid, who moved it to Brown for a dunk.
“He’s a great, great passer, and that was certainly on display tonight,” Nurse said of James, who is also fourth on the NBA's list with more than 12,000 assists. Nurse wanted to play his starters about half the game, though Embiid was still on the floor to start the second half with Brown and Edgecombe.
Most of them sat out a victory over theThe new guy seemed already in charge in his new locker room, turning the music on loud when he returned from a pregame workout to continue getting ready. His blue 76ers uniform sat folded on the floor next to his chair.
“Obviously, I have my routine, but when you go through an offseason, you’ve got to remember what your routine was again, no matter how many, how long you’ve been in it," James said. "So, just thinking about, like, which buses do I remember taking, you know? What was my routine when I got over to the arena? How do I get ready for the game and things of that nature.
“So all that stuff plays a part. So I’m still getting into the whole everything, on the court and off the court, living and also being around these guys every day. It’s a lot of adjustment for me, but, every day we’ll get better and better. ”, who traded Brown to Philadelphia shortly before James signed.
